title: Grateful Dead Live at College Of William & Mary Hall on 1973-09-11
source: Master Soundboard Reels to DAT 16 bit 44.1kHz from ANON Also, a Kind LL member shared uncirculated lo-fi audience tapes to patch a few spots

ai_review.summary: First‑class soundboard recording, though the second set (especially the horn sit‑ins) is considered skippable by many listeners.
ai_review.review: The recording quality of this 1973 show is described as impeccable and crystal‑clear, earning top marks for its soundboard source. However, the reviewer notes that the early horn‑filled section of the second set—and much of that set overall—fails to engage them, making it largely skippable. The contrast leaves the overall impression mixed despite the stellar audio.

ai_rating.rationale: Excellent soundboard recording (5‑star praise) but a second set that many find uninteresting; with only one review, confidence is low and the mixed show quality drags the overall rating down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Impeccable, crisp, first‑class sound; no noted flaws or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set not commented on; early portion of the second set with horn sit‑ins is deemed less compelling, making much of that set feel skippable.
